outcome: Severe maternal morbidity with and without transfusion
Moderate and severe unexpected newborn complications
cohort: Deliveries at hospitals with at least 100 deliveries per year in the 2016 Nationwide Readmission Database
finding: Hospitals with lower cesarean delivery rates had lower rates of severe maternal morbidity (including transfusion) but similar rates of unexpected newborn complications compared to hospitals with higher cesarean delivery rates.
